message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A long weekend is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday (or is observed on a Monday if it falls on a weekend).  The table shows the holiday name, the date it was observed, and the weekend‑extended period that you can take off for a “long weekend” trip.

| # | Holiday | 2023 Observed Date | Weekend‑Extended Period | Notes |
|---|---------|--------------------|------------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** (Observed Monday, Jan 2) | **Sun Jan 1 – Tue Jan 3** | Canada observes the holiday on Monday if it falls on a weekend. |
| 2 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | **Monday, Feb 20** | **Mon Feb 20 – Fri Feb 24** | Only in provinces that observe Family Day. |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Friday, Mar 31** | **Fri Mar 31 – Mon Apr 3** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in most provinces. |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Monday, May 22** | **Mon May 22 – Fri May 26** | National holiday. |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Saturday, Jul 1** (Observed Monday, Jul 3) | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** | Observed on Monday if it falls on a weekend. |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Monday, Sep 4** | **Mon Sep 4 – Fri Sep 8** | National holiday. |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Monday, Oct 9** | **Mon Oct 9 – Fri Oct 13** | National holiday. |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | **Saturday, Nov 11** (Observed Monday, Nov 13) | **Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13** | Observed on Monday if it falls on a weekend. |
| 9 | Christmas | **Monday, Dec 25** | **Mon Dec 25 – Fri Dec 29** | National holiday. |
|10 | Boxing Day | **Tuesday, Dec 26** | **Tue Dec 26 – Fri Dec 29** | National holiday. |

### How to Use This List

- **Planning a trip**: Pick any of the weekend‑extended periods above for a quick getaway.  
- **Province‑specific holidays**: If you’re in a province that observes a holiday not listed (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or Heritage Day in British Columbia), you can add those dates to your personal calendar.  
- **Work‑day adjustments**: For holidays that fall on a weekday (e.g., Good Friday, Labour Day), you’ll have a normal work week but still enjoy a long weekend if you take the preceding Friday or following Monday off.

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or spreadsheet. If you need the same information for a different year or for a specific province, let me know!
